source: 705 Past
target: 705 Praeteritum

source: After the waiter left their secluded table with the order, Lumian picked up his tri‑colored liqueur—a vibrant mix of red, white, and blue—and clinked glasses with Franca before taking a sip.
target: Postquam caupo mensam reconditam cum iussu reliquit, Lumian potum tribicolor suum — mixturam vibranti rubri, albi, et caerulei — arripuit et vitreis calices cum Franca tintillavit, antequam sorbere coepit.

source: Glancing around to ensure no one could overhear, he quietly recounted the detailed fate fragments of Moran Avigny.
target: Circumspiciens, ne quis auscultare possit, tacite enarravit accurata fragmenta fati de Moran Avigny.

source: As Franca listened, her expression gradually morphed, a frown creasing her lovely brow.
target: Dum Franca auscultabat, vultus eius paulatim mutatus est, rugam in fronte decora effingens.

source: “That white, thin fog you described… it reminds me of something,” she said.
target: “Illam album tenuemque nebulam quam describuisti… aliquid mihi recordari facit,” inquit.

source: “Does it have a mercurial, ever‑shifting nature?”
target: “Num habet naturam mercurialem et semper mutablem?”

source: Lumian considered briefly before nodding.
target: Lumian brevi cogitavit antequam caput annuit.

source: “Yes, it does.”
target: “Ita, habet.”

source: Franca let out a soft sigh.
target: Franca leniter suspiravit.

source: “It must be the same phenomenon then. You know how I told you about Jenna and I getting tailed by that entrustee of the vanished Deep Valley Cloister gatekeeper at the mysticism gathering? The one we ended up fighting?”
target: “Ergo idem phaenomenon esse debet. Scisne quomodo tibi narraverim de Jenna et me a illo procuratore, qui closter Deep Valley evanuerat, secuti esse? Illum, quem tandem pugnavimus?”

source: “Well, when I channeled the guy’s spirit and asked about his organizational ties, his physical form and spirit abruptly detonated.
target: “Bene, cum spiritum illius evocavi et de nexibus eius quaesivi, forma eius corporalis et animus subito detonaverunt.

source: My mirror cracked from the blast, but right before shattering, it filled with that same thin, mercurial white mist.”
target: Speculum meum impetu fractum est, sed iusto antequam ruina esset, impletum est eadem tenue, mercuriali alba nebula.

source: Franca paused, collecting her thoughts.
target: Franca pausavit, cogitationes suas colligens.

source: “According to the intel I passed along, 007 ran into a similar fog during their investigation of Deep Valley Town.
target: Secundum nuntium quem transmissem, 007 in nebulam similem incidit, dum oppidum Deep Valley investigaretur.

source: Albert Goncourt, the Carbonari’s leader, was spotted there too.
target: Albert Goncourt, dux Carbonari, ibi quoque deprehensus est.

source: As you’re aware, the Carbonari played a role in stoking the riots during the Hostel plan.
target: Ut scis, Carbonarii partem egere in incitatione tumultuum sub consilio Hostel.

source: Their other leader, operating under the alias General Philip, spearheaded that particular scheme.”
target: Alter dux, sub nomine Generalis Philip, illud consilium praeivit.

source: Lumian swiftly connected the dots Franca was laying out.
target: Lumian celeriter notiones quas Franca proponebat coniunxit.

source: “So you suspect the Carbonari is in league with multiple evil god cults, this peculiar white fog being tied to one of them—and that Moran Avigny is also entangled with this group. Meaning our supposedly chance encounter with him in the West Lognes Forest was anything but.”
target: “Ita suspicis Carbonarios cum plurimis cultibus deorum malignorum consociatos esse, hoc singulare album nebula ad unum ex illis pertinere, et quod Moran Avigny quoque in hanc societatem implicatus sit; id igitur significat conventum nostrum cum eo in Silva Lognes Occidentali, putatum fortuito fuisse non.”

source: “Precisely.”
target: “Prorsum.”

source: Franca took another sip of her liqueur.
target: Franca alium sorbetionem potus sui cepit.

source: “And what’s the ultimate endgame for these Mirror People? Surely not mere replacement of their originals.”
target: “Et quid est ultimus finis horum Hominum Specularum? Pro certo non est solum substitutio originalium.”

source: The mirror version of Gardner Martin had failed to succeed the real one, understandably using the Hostel plan to deal with his counterpart.
target: Specularis imago Gardner Martin veram non supplere potuit, ideo consilium Hostel ad contrarium tractandum intelligenter adhibitum est.

source: But Moran Avigny, also a Mirror Person, had quietly replaced the original for decades, even fathering an illegitimate daughter and living a cushy life.
target: Sed Moran Avigny, quoque Hominum Specularum, originalem per decennia tacite substituit, filiam illegitimam genens et vitam commodam agens.

source: Why collaborate with cults?
target: Cur cum cultibus cooperari?

source: Smiling, Lumian replied, “The goals of Mirror People as a whole versus as individuals are bound to differ.
target: Subridente, Lumian respondit: “Proposita Hominum Specularum, tamquam unum genus aut ut singula, certe differre debent.

source: Investigating should reveal the former.
target: Investigatio primum propositum ostendere debet.

source: Back in Fourth Epoch Trier, Mirror Gardner Martin mentioned their loyalty and service to someone who holds all the answers.
target: In Trier, quarto aevo, Gardner Martin Specularis de sua fide et ministerio erga aliquem, qui omnia responsa tenet, locutus est.

source: Learning that person’s identity should tell us the Mirror People’s endgame.”
target: Cognitio identitatis illius personae nobis finem propositi Hominum Specularum revelabit.

source: Franca concurred succinctly, “We can plan our next moves around this strange fog.
target: Franca succincte accessit: “Movimenta nostra futura circa hanc nebulam insolitam disponere possumus.

source: Deal with Moran Avigny to get more info on the Mirror People, which is already a lead.
target: Negotia fac cum Moran Avigny ut plura de Hominibus Specularibus cognoscamus, quod iam indicium est.

source: And capturing him or channeling his spirit could present other opportunities.”
target: Et eum capere aut spiritum eius evocare alias occasiones afferre potest.

source: Franca smiled.
target: Franca subridens.

source: “Looks like 007 will be busy again.”
target: “Videtur 007 iterum occupatus fore.”

source: Their discussion of Moran Avigny complete, Lumian picked up some roasted pre‑meal bread, chewing as he recounted his encounter with Courtesan Perle and the coffee ground divination he’d witnessed.
target: Eorum de Moran Avigny sermo confectus, Lumian panem prae‑cenam torrefactum arripuit, masticans, dum narrabat de congressu suo cum Courtesana Perle et de divinatione ex pulveri caffeae, quam testatus fuerat.

source: “She’s unlikely to be a Demoness,” Franca concluded, a hint of disappointment in her voice.
target: “Illam vix daemonissa fore puto,” Franca concludit, leviter tristitia in voce insinuans.

source: Based on Lumian’s description and reaction to Perle’s appearance, she could tell the courtesan wasn’t a Demoness.
target: Ex enarratione Lumiani et responsione ad speciem Perle, illa intellexit Courtesanam daemonissam non esse.

source: Unless deliberately feigning ugliness, a Demoness’s charms were impossible to conceal.
target: Nisi dolo foeditiam fingat, amoenitates daemonissae celari non possunt.

source: Even gay men couldn’t resist sneaking a few extra glances.
target: Etiam viri homosexuales non potuerunt non furtim pauca aspectus additos intueri.

source: “Definitely not…” Lumian suddenly paused, remembering something.
target: “Certe minime…” Lumian subito cessavit, aliquid recordans.

source: Shifting to casual conversation, he asked, “Does coffee ground divination actually hold mystical significance? Can it truly provide revelation?”
target: Conversus ad sermonem levem, rogavit: “Num divinatio ex pulveri caffeae vere significationem mysticam habeat? Num vere revelationem praebet?”

source: Franca finished her bread, took another sip of the colorful liqueur, and smiled.
target: Franca panem suum consumpsit, alium sorbetionem potus colorati cepit, et subridens arridit.

source: “Of course mysticism is involved.”
target: “Certe, mysteria implicantur.”

source: Noting Lumian’s lack of divination knowledge compared to his skill in reading fate, Franca explained with a smug grin.
target: Animadvertens defectum scientiae divinandi Lumiani comparatum ad artem fatum legendi, Franca facie superba explicavit.

source: “You don’t need to put divination on some holy, unattainable pedestal.
target: “Non opus est divinationem in aliquem sanctum, inaccessibilem statuam ponere.

source: “Our Astral Projections constantly interact with the spirit world, obtaining information and receiving revelations.
target: “Nostrae Proiectiones Astrales constanter cum mundo spirituum interagunt, notitias obtinent et revelationes accipiunt.

source: These get reflected in reality through various forms.
target: Hae in re variis modis reflectuntur.

source: It’s true for both Beyonders and ordinary people.
target: Hoc verum est tam pro Beyonders quam pro hominibus ordinariis.

source: But those unskilled in divination struggle to proactively obtain revelations or effectively interpret them.
target: Sed eos, qui in divinatione inexperti sunt, difficulter revelationes proactivas obtinere aut efficaciter interpretari possunt.

source: For example, if a Beyonder chokes on a fishbone while eating, they’ll quickly realize it’s a warning from their spirit, containing a revelation needing interpretation.
target: Exempli gratia, si Beyonder ossa piscium in edendo suffocatur, celeriter intellexerit hoc esse monitionem spiritus sui, revelationem interpretandam continens.

source: But if regular folks have the same experience, they’ll just think they were unlucky or careless.
target: Sed, si communes homines eandem experientiam habent, putabunt se tantum infortunatos aut neglegentes fuisse.

source: It won’t stand out enough to warrant deeper consideration or deciphering.
target: Non satis eminent ut altiori considerationi aut interpretationi subiciatur.

source: Of course, getting a stuck fishbone doesn’t always indicate a spiritual warning.
target: Certe, ossa piscis haerentia accipiendi non semper indicat admonitionem spiritualem.

source: Usually it’s just lack of care.
target: Saepe id tantum neglegentia curae est.

source: Skilled diviners can tell the difference between a true revelation and a random occurrence.
target: Periti divinatores differentiam inter veram revelationem et casum fortuitum discernere possunt.

source: The unskilled tend to overthink, scaring themselves while ignoring what’s truly concerning.
target: Inepti tendunt nimis cogitare, se terrosos facientes, dum id quod vere solliciti esse debet neglegunt.

source: Given their upcoming fish course, Franca had used a relatable example.
target: Propter imminens prandium piscale, Franca exemplo idoneo usus erat.

source: Lumian nodded, gaining a clearer understanding of divination.
target: Lumian caput annuit, divinandi melius notitiam adipiscens.

source: He asked thoughtfully, “So without deliberate control over the drinking method, coffee ground patterns can reveal something—but ordinary people’s interpretations may be inaccurate?”
target: Rogavit cogitans: “Itaque, sine deliberato potandi regimine, figurae pulveris caffeae aliquid revelare possunt—sed interpretationes hominum ordinariorum fortasse inexactae erunt?”

source: “Precisely!” Franca said excitedly.
target: “Prorsum!” Franca dixit ferventer.

source: “In the most rational environment, the decades‑popular coffee ground divination can come extremely close to reality.
target: “In ambitu maxime rationali, divinatio ex pulveri caffeae, quae per decennia nota est, ad veritatem prope accedere potest.

source: Each divination session can refine the standard interpretations until the meaning of every ground formation is definitively established.
target: Quisque sessio divinatoria interpretationes communes emendare potest, donec significatio cuiusque formationis pulveris certo constituta sit.

source: Then even regular people could interpret with reasonable accuracy.
target: Tum etiam homines ordinarii interpretationem cum ratione accurata praestare possent.

source: Sadly, reality is no bastion of pure rationality.
target: Sed, realitas non est munimentum rationis purae.

source: Believers in coffee divination subconsciously work to make even mistaken interpretations come true.
target: Credentes in divinatione ex pulveri caffeae subconscie operantur, ut etiam interpretationes erratae verae fieri possint.

source: Non‑believers plainly see the interpretations don’t match up.
target: Non credentes manifeste vident interpretationes non congruere.

source: These conflicting approaches get all tangled together, preventing the codification of standard, reliable answers.
target: Hae rationes discordantes inter se implicantur, quod codificationem responsorum standardorum et certorum impediat.

source: In the end, it’s just a game.
target: Denique, solum ludus est.

source: As they conversed, the waiter served the various dishes, clearing used plates as part of the set procedure.
target: Dum colloquebantur, caupo varia fercula ministrabat, patinas usitatas purgans, secundum consuetudinem.

source: The fried Fürth fish arrived as a later main course.
target: Piscis Fürth fritus advenit ut posterius ferculum principale.

source: Lumian cut a piece and tasted it—tender flesh with an intriguing blend of charred and oily notes, the pepper and salt seasoning just right.
target: Lumian partem secavit et gustavit—caro tener cum mixtura ex ustis et oleosis notarum, condimentis piperis et salis temperatis admodum apta.

source: “Delicious,” Franca praised.
target: “Deliciosum,” Franca laudavit.

source: “And warming too.”
target: “Et quoque calefaciens.”

source: Lumian also felt a current of warmth spread through him as the Fürth fish reached his stomach.
target: Lumian etiam sensit caliditatis flumen per se diffundi, cum piscis Fürth in ventrem eius pervenit.

source: “Some special ingredients indeed,” he concluded, teasing Franca.
target: “Vere, specialia ingredientia sunt,” inquit, Franca iocose provocans.

source: “Just don’t eat too fast—wouldn’t want you choking on a bone.”
target: “Modo ne nimis celeriter edas—nolo ut ossa te suffocent.”

source: Franca laughed.
target: Franca risit.

source: “You think a few bones can choke me?”
target: “Putone pauca ossa me suffocare posse?”

source: Glancing around to confirm the waiter’s departure, she asked,
target: Circumspiciens ut discessum cauponis confirmaret, rogavit:

source: “I’ve been pondering something the last couple days.
target: “His proximis diebus aliquid meditatus sum.

source: I still can’t grasp the difference between using rituals and curses to influence a target’s future fate versus directly compelling a fate change.
target: Nondum intellego discrimen inter usum ritus et maledictionum ad fatum futuri destinatum afficiendum, et directam mutationem fatum coegerendam.

source: Lumian organized his thoughts before explaining.
target: Lumian cogitationes suas ordinavit antequam explicare coepit.

source: “In the mysticism knowledge of Fate Appropriators, a curse is a curse of fate.
target: “In scientia mystica Fatorum Appropriatorum, maledictio est maledictio fatum.

source: “Compared to rituals, curses are simpler, with fewer required conditions.
target: “Comparatis ritibus, maledictio simplicior est, cum pauciores conditiones necessariae sint.

source: But that significantly limits the ultimate effect.
target: Sed hoc effectum ultimum significanter limitat.

source: Nothing too outlandish can be achieved.
target: Nihil nimis insolitum effici potest.

source: Many bestowed of Inevitability like to call this type of curse Magnified Fate.
target: Multi, qui Inevitabilitate donati sunt, hunc genus maledictionis “Fatum Magnificatum” appellare malunt.

source: It can only target fate tributaries within the next ten seconds, and must align with the current environment and circumstances.
target: Illud solum potest intendere ad fatum tributaria intra proximos decem secundos, et debet convenire cum ambitu et circumstantiis praesentibus.

source: Meeting those prerequisites enables the fate curse to succeed.
target: Cum illa praerequisita impleta sunt, maledictio fatum succedere sinit.

source: And the targeted fate tributary needs a certain probability of manifesting in the first place, or the success rate plummets.
target: Et fatum tributarium destinatum certa probabilitate manifestandi opus habet, alioquin ratio successus labitur.

source: Simply put, one first uses or alters the environment to enable certain possibilities, then magnifies those possibilities—assuming they weren’t extremely unlikely to begin with.
target: Simpliciter, primo ambitum utitur aut mutat, ut certas possibilitates fieri possint, deinde has possibilitates amplificat—supponendo eas non ab initio nimis improbabiles fuisse.

source: Lumian looked at Franca, raising his right palm to gesture as he mischievously provided an example.
target: Lumian Francam aspexit, dextram manum levans ad gestum faciendum, dum ludibriose exemplo praebebat.

source: “For instance, while you’re eating fish, I could use a curse to magnify the chance of you choking on a bone.
target: “Exempli gratia, dum piscem edis, maledictione uti possem ad augendam facultatem ut ossa te suffocare incitarent.

source: “But I couldn’t magnify the chance of your chair suddenly collapsing, impaling you with wood splinters.”
target: “Sed non possem augere facultatem ut sella tua subito corrueret, te lignorum fragmentis aculeis impingeret.”

source: The moment he finished speaking, Franca froze, gasping twice as her throat worked.
target: Mox postquam locutus est, Franca immobilis facta est, bis suspirans, dum guttur eius operabatur.

source: Within seconds, she spat out a bloody fishbone.
target: In paucis secundis, exspuit ossa piscis sanguinolenta.

source: “You actually did it?” Franca grumbled.
target: “Revera id fecisti?” Franca murmuravit.

source: “Luckily my Sequence grants strong throat control.
target: “Fortunate, mea Sequence validam moderationem gutturis concedit.

source: I handled it myself.
target: Ego ipse id curavi.

source: “Uh…” Franca suddenly paused.
target: “Uh…” Franca subito cessavit.

source: After a few seconds, she said, “Otherwise we’d be seeking a doctor’s aid.
target: Post paucas secundas, inquit: “Alioquin medicum quaressemus.

source: How embarrassing would that be!”
target: “Quam vere pudendum id esset!”

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian cachinnavit.

source: “I could’ve helped pull it out, magnifying the fate tributary of successful extraction.”
target: “Possem id extrahere adiuvare, fatum tributarium extractionis felicis augeando.”

source: Franca was briefly speechless.
target: Franca breviter muta fuit.

source: After eating another bite of Fürth fish, she nodded.
target: Postquam alium morsum piscis Fürth edidit, caput annuit.

source: “I understand the differences now.
target: “Nunc differentias intellego.

source: “Curses, or Magnify, suit combat.
target: “Maledictiones, aut Fatum Magnificatum, certaminibus conveniunt.

source: They’re mainly for interfering with and influencing enemies, not accomplishing anything too exaggerated.
target: Praecipue ad hostes impediendos et influendos sunt, non ad res nimis exaggeratas perficiendas.

source: Rituals are done in advance.
target: Ritus antea peraguntur.

source: With the right items, they can largely steer a target’s fate as desired.
target: Cum rebus idoneis, fatum obiectum prorsus, ut optatur, dirigere possunt.

source: “But only in a general direction,” Lumian added.
target: “Sed solum in directione generali,” Lumian addidit.

source: “No real precision.
target: “Nulla vera praecisio.

source: I could make someone have a bad day, but not dictate the exact flavor of misfortune.”
target: Ego alicui diem malum efficere possum, sed non exacte gustum infortunii determinare.

source: Franca nodded.
target: Franca caput annuit.

source: “So compelling fate is like a streamlined ritual for live combat that still packs a punch?”
target: “Ergo fatum compellere est quasi ritualis compendiosa pro certamine vivente, quae tamen vim affert?”

source: “Perhaps even stronger and more precise effects,” Lumian mused.
target: “Forsitan etiam effectus fortiores et magis precisos,” Lumian meditatus est.

source: “Plus, many abilities transformed in unique ways when Fate Appropriator and Reaper fused, bringing with them the relevant mystical knowledge.
target: “Praeterea, multae facultates in modis singulares transformatae sunt, cum Fatorum Appropriator et Reaper se contulerunt, simul pertinentem scientiam mysticam afferentes.

source: “I can’t fully distinguish the inherent from the individualized—I only know the Eye of Calamity and Compelling Fate came from Reaper.”
target: “Non possum plene distinguere quod sit inherens ab individuato—solum scio Oculum Calamitatis et Fatum Compellens ex Reaper provenisse.”

source: They enjoyed the rest of their lunch.
target: Reliquam prandii partem fruebantur.

source: “As the meal concluded, Lumian pointed to the half‑eaten Fürth fish, instructing the waiter, ‘I’d like this wrapped up to go.’”
target: “Cum prandium confectum esset, Lumian ad piscem Fürth dimidium editum ostendit et cauponi praecipiens dedit: ‘Hoc involutum mihi tolli velim.’

source: The waiter complied respectfully without question.
target: Caupo oboedivit reverenter, sine quaestionibus.

source: Franca smiled teasingly.
target: Franca subridens iocose arridit.

source: “How frugal of you.”
target: “Quam parcus es.”

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian cachinnavit.

source: “This is expected of a godfather.
target: “Hoc a padrino exspectatur.

source: “Besides, I’m curious what makes this fish so special.”
target: “Praeterea, curiosus sum quid hunc piscem tam speciale faciat.”
